boundary_basis: All eight entries match MIPS .pdr procedure entries. The next .pdr procedure supplies the exclusive upper bound; constructor pointers corroborate entry identity. Every bounded word disassembled; every entry has a MIPS PIC gp setup and bounded return/control flow.
